text:
rachel: FYI we got a customer bug — duplicate invoices when client hits 429 then immediately rotates token and retries. sample app (node) was copied verbatim.

omar: that pattern is classic: no idempotency header + tight retries = duplicate side-effects.

lee: what if onboarding sample app sets `Idempotency-Key` per action and uses exponential+full jitter for retries? small code snippet in README.

rachel: yes. also we should pause queued retries while auth refresh is in-flight so they don't replay with stale tokens.

omar: telemetry idea: increment `retry.duplicate` counter when server returns dedupe conflict; sample app should expose it at /metrics.

lee: I'll draft a tiny repro script `scripts/repro-429-token-race.sh` for the repo so engineers can run the race locally.

devex-bot: created checklist: add Idempotency-Key in sample app, switch to full-jitter backoff, implement retry-queue wait for token update, add telemetry counters. Assigned to @rachel and @omar. :white_check_mark:

rachel: opening a draft PR now with tests that simulate 429+refresh and assert no duplicates. will link here when ready. closing for now.
